038import java.lang.System.Logger;
039import java.sql.SQLException;
040
041import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
042import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
043import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
044import javax.swing.text.AttributeSet;
045import javax.swing.text.BadLocationException;
046import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;
047import javax.swing.text.JTextComponent;

050import static dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.Utils.postColumnChangeStartError;

054/**
055 * Support for use with SsComponents that extend JTextComponent.
056 */
057public class SsTextSupport {
058  private SsTextSupport() {}
059
060  /** Logger for component */
061  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
062
063  /**
064   * Returns SsDocumentListener; error if not SsComponent.
065   * <p>
066   * Should only be called once per component.
067   *
068   * @param jtc Listener for this.
069   * @return SsDocumentListener for a JTextComponent
070   */
071  public static SsDocumentListener getSsDocumentListener(JTextComponent jtc) {
072    if (!(jtc instanceof SsComponent comp))
073      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not an SsComponent");
074    // TODO: assert not called before
075    return new SsTextSupport.SsDocumentListener(comp);
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Document listener provided for convenience for SwingSet Components that are
080   * based on JTextComponents. SwingSet components that need a Document listener
081   * to trigger a change to the bound RowSet should return an instance of
082   * SsCommonDocumentListener() when implementing the abstract method
083   * getSsComponentListener().
084   * <p>
085   * This listener updates the underlying RowSet when there is a change to the Document
086   * object. E.g., a call to setText() on a JTextField.
087   * <p>
088   * removeUpdate() and insertUpdate() both call changedUpdate().
089   * changedUpdate() uses counters and SwingUtilities.invokeLater() to only update
090   * the display after the last method is called.
091   * <p>
092   * DocumentListener events generally, but not always get fired twice any time
093   * there is an update to the JTextField: a removeUpdate() followed by
094   * insertUpdate()
095   * <a href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/15209766/why-jtextfield-settext-will-fire-documentlisteners-removeupdate-before-change#15213813">as described here</a>.
096   */
097  // <a href="https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3953208/value-change-listener-to-jtextfield">partial solution</a>.
098  public static class SsDocumentListener implements DocumentListener {
099    /**
100     * variables needed to consolidate calls to removeUpdate() and insertUpdate()
101     * from DocumentListener
102     */
103    private int lastChange = 0;
104    private int lastNotifiedChange = 0;
105    private final SsCommon ssCommon;
106
107    /**
108     * Create DocumentListener for the component.
109     * @param comp associated component
110     */
111    public SsDocumentListener(SsComponent comp) {
112      this.ssCommon = comp.getSsCommon();
113    }
114
115    private void updateTextComponent() {
116      String text = ((JTextComponent) ssCommon.getSsComponent()).getText();
117      // update decorator per keystroke.
118      // ISSUE: when decorator uses NavigateState.errorComponents,
119      // as accessed through RowsModel.hasError(comp), that state may
120      // still be there, since it's updated by RowSet event,
121      // which comes from setColumnText.
122      try {
123        ssCommon.skipValidateHasError = true;
124        if (!ssCommon.decorate()) {
125          postColumnChangeStartError(ssCommon.getSsComponent(), text);
126          return;
127        }
128      } finally {
129        ssCommon.skipValidateHasError = false;
130      }
131      ssCommon.setColumnText(text);
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Coalesce events so that updateTextComponent is only called one.
136     * {@inheritDoc}
137     */
138    @Override
139    public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
140      lastChange++;
141      logger.log(TRACE,
142                 () -> sf("%s - changedUpdate(): lastChange=%s, lastNotifiedChange=%s",
143                          ssCommon.getColumnForLog(), lastChange, lastNotifiedChange));
144      // Delay updateTextComponent until all Document listeners inovked for event.
145      // See: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3953208/value-change-listener-to-jtextfield
146      SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
147        if (lastNotifiedChange != lastChange) {
148          lastNotifiedChange = lastChange;
149          try {
150            ssCommon.dbChange(() -> updateTextComponent());
151          } catch (SQLException ex) {
152            logger.log(Logger.Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
153          }
154        }
155      });
156    }
157
158    /** {@inheritDoc} */
159    @Override
160    public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
161      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s - insertUpdate().", ssCommon.getColumnForLog()));
162      changedUpdate(de);
163    }
164
165    /** {@inheritDoc} */
166    @Override
167    public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
168      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s - removeUpdate().", ssCommon.getColumnForLog()));
169      changedUpdate(de);
170    }
171  }
172
173  ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
174  //
175  // Everything following is private, targetted for removal
176  //
177
178  /**
179   * For JTextField to track previous text field value.
180   * Used in conjunction with {@link SsDocumentListener}.
181   * <p>
182   * Part of the fix for<br>
183   * Text field has wrong value after error while editing<br>
184   * https://github.com/bpangburn/swingset/issues/175<br>
185   * Which came in with<br>
186   * Fix error recovery after errors during SsTextField edit<br>
187   * https://github.com/bpangburn/swingset/pull/178<br>
188   *
189   */
190  @SuppressWarnings(value = {"serial", "unused"})
191  private static class SsPlainDocument extends PlainDocument {
192    DocumentFilter filter;
193    private final SsCommon ssCommon;
194    /**
195     * Create DocumentListener for the component.
196     * @param comp associated component
197     */
198    public SsPlainDocument(SsComponent comp) {
199      this.ssCommon = comp.getSsCommon();
200    }
201
202    void capturePrevious(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb) {
203      try {
204        String prev = fb.getDocument().getText(0, fb.getDocument().getLength());
205        logger.log(TRACE, () -> "Capture previous text value: " + prev);
206        if (ssCommon.getEventListener() instanceof SsDocumentListenerWithRestoreOnError listener)
207          listener.previousValue = prev;
208      } catch (BadLocationException ex) {
209        logger.log(DEBUG, "Capture previous text value", ex);
210      }
211    }
212
213    /** {@inheritDoc} */
214    @Override
215    public DocumentFilter getDocumentFilter() {
216      if (filter == null)
217        filter = new DocumentFilter() {
218          @Override
219          public void replace(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text,
220                              AttributeSet attrs) throws BadLocationException {
221            capturePrevious(fb);
222            super.replace(fb, offset, length, text, attrs);
223          }
224
225          @Override
226          public void insertString(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, String string,
227                                   AttributeSet attr) throws BadLocationException {
228            capturePrevious(fb);
229            super.insertString(fb, offset, string, attr);
230          }
231
232          @Override
233          public void remove(DocumentFilter.FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length)
234              throws BadLocationException {
235            capturePrevious(fb);
236            super.remove(fb, offset, length);
237          }
238        };
239      return filter;
240    }
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Document listener provided for convenience for SwingSet Components that are
245   * based on JTextComponents. SwingSet components that need a Document listener
246   * to trigger a change to the bound RowSet should return an instance of
247   * SsCommonDocumentListener() when implementing the abstract method
248   * getSsComponentListener().
249   * <p>
250   * A typical implementation might look like: {@code
251   return getSsCommon().getSsDocumentListener();
252}
253   * <p>
254   * This listener updates the underlying RowSet when there is a change to the Document
255   * object. E.g., a call to setText() on a JTextField. If the update has an error
256   * the text field is reverted to the current contents of the database.
257   * <p>
258   * DocumentListener events generally, but not always get fired twice any time
259   * there is an update to the JTextField: a removeUpdate() followed by
260   * insertUpdate(). See:
261   * https://stackoverflow.com/questions/15209766/why-jtextfield-settext-will-fire-documentlisteners-removeupdate-before-change#15213813
262   * <p>
263   * Using partial solution here from here:
264   * https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3953208/value-change-listener-to-jtextfield
265   * <p>
266   * Having removeUpdate() and insertUpdate() both call changedUpdate().
267   * changedUpdate() uses counters and SwingUtilities.invokeLater() to only update
268   * the display on the last method called.
269   */
270  private static class SsDocumentListenerWithRestoreOnError implements DocumentListener {
271    /**
272     * variables needed to consolidate calls to removeUpdate() and insertUpdate()
273     * from DocumentListener
274     */
275    private int lastChange = 0;
276    private int lastNotifiedChange = 0;
277    private String previousValue = null;
278    /** True when listener is temporarily removed. */
279    private final SsCommon ssCommon;
280
281    /**
282     * Create DocumentListener for the component.
283     * @param comp associated component
284     */
285    public SsDocumentListenerWithRestoreOnError(SsComponent comp) {
286      this.ssCommon = comp.getSsCommon();
287    }
288
289    /** {@inheritDoc} */
290    @Override
291    public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
292      lastChange++;
293      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s - changedUpdate(): lastChange=%s, lastNotifiedChange=%s",
294                                 ssCommon.getColumnForLog(), lastChange, lastNotifiedChange));
295      // Delay updateTextComponent until all Document listeners inovked for event.
296      // See: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3953208/value-change-listener-to-jtextfield
297      SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
298        if (lastNotifiedChange != lastChange) {
299          lastNotifiedChange = lastChange;
300          try {
301            ssCommon.dbChange(() -> updateTextComponent());
302          } catch (SQLException ex) {
303            logger.log(Logger.Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
304          }
305        }
306      });
307    }
308
309    /** This could be in updateTextComponent (like as an array element). */
310    private boolean listenerNeedsRestoration;
311
312    private void updateTextComponent() {
313      String text = ((JTextComponent) ssCommon.getSsComponent()).getText();
314      // update decorator per keystroke.
315      // ISSUE: when decorator uses NavigateState.errorComponents,
316      // as accessed through RowsModel.hasError(comp), that state may
317      // still be there, since it's updated by RowSet event,
318      // which comes from setColumnText.
319      try {
320        ssCommon.skipValidateHasError = true;
321        if (!ssCommon.decorate()) {
322          postColumnChangeStartError(ssCommon.getSsComponent(), text);
323          return;
324        }
325      } finally {
326        ssCommon.skipValidateHasError = false;
327      }
328      boolean ok = true;
329      //boolean inErrorState = ssCommon.getRowsModel().hasError(ssCommon.getSsComponent());
330      try {
331        ok = ssCommon.setColumnText(text);
332      } finally {
333        if (!ok) {
334          if (ssCommon.isRestoreOnError_NOT_USED()) {
335            // restore previous text value
336            if (previousValue != null) {
337              if (ssCommon.isSsComponentListenerAdded()) {
338                // avoid generating events while restoring text
339                ssCommon.removeSsComponentListener();
340                listenerNeedsRestoration = true;
341              }
342              try {
343                logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: restoring previous value '%s'",
344                                           ssCommon.getColumnForLog(), previousValue));
345                ((JTextComponent) ssCommon.getSsComponent()).setText(previousValue);
346              } finally {
347                if (listenerNeedsRestoration) {
348                  listenerNeedsRestoration = false;
349                  ssCommon.addSsComponentListener();
350                }
351              }
352              // RESTORE ERROR STATE
353            }
354          }
355          // Things may have changed, re-decorate.
356          ssCommon.decorate();
357        }
358        previousValue = null; // Seems safer, is this the right spot?
359      }
360    }
361
362    /** {@inheritDoc} */
363    @Override
364    public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
365      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s - insertUpdate().", ssCommon.getColumnForLog()));
366      changedUpdate(de);
367    }
368
369    /** {@inheritDoc} */
370    @Override
371    public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent de) {
372      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s - removeUpdate().", ssCommon.getColumnForLog()));
373      changedUpdate(de);
374    }
375
376  } // end protected class SsDocumentListener
377}
